query_lineage.sql: SELECT s.record_id,s.entry_id,s.payload,d.domains,d.code,l.lemma,l.pos,l.gloss FROM source_observations s JOIN definition_states d ON d.entry_id=s.entry_id JOIN lexemes l ON l.id=d.lexeme_id WHERE s.source='wordnet_hierarchy' AND s.scope='lexical' ORDER BY s.record_id
query_lineage.accepted_receipts_scope: Active accepted receipts only; archives were not queried and absence does not claim no historical receipt exists.
query_lineage.ranking: Descending positive SUBTLEX spelling count, then QUANTITY domain cardinality, then descending known bank count, then entry_id; first entry per distinct native synset.
query_lineage.source_hash: SHA256 UTF-8 canonical JSON, sorted keys, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, compact comma/colon separators
query_lineage.branch_count_warning: Multiple native ancestry paths can put a sense in more than one immediate branch; branch totals are not additive.
